takes.h: Lividian sets shipping for McCammon's Baal and Bethany's Sin
takes.p: Baal, Book 1 of Lividian Publications' Robert McCammon Library, is open for preorder and shipping in late November, the press's production update says. Book 2, Bethany's Sin, is set to ship in late December; The Night Boat, They Thirst, Mystery Walk and Usher's Passing are in production for 2027.
